scope: Illustration assets; documented card abilities are not implemented by this pack.

cards.name: Steady Hand

cards.name: Ace High
cards.effect: Aces played as 11 give +8 Chips

cards.name: Low Roller
cards.effect: +1 Mult per card valued 6 or under in the played hand

cards.name: Face Value
cards.effect: +10 Chips per face card in the played hand

cards.name: Small Time
cards.effect: +20 Chips flat on every hand

cards.name: Careful Player
cards.effect: +3 Mult if you stood without ever hitting this hand

cards.name: Bold Play

cards.name: Warm Up
cards.effect: +1 Mult on each of the first 3 hands played per level
